title: Constraint satisfaction criterion
statement: Let $G$ be a finite unique game, let $e$ be a constraint with source $u$, target $v$, and attached permutation $\pi_e$, and assign a label from the $q$-element label set to every vertex. The constraint is satisfied if and only if $\pi_e$ sends the label of $v$ to the label of $u$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite unique game with distinct constraint endpoints
A labeling of every vertex by one of the $q$ labels
